source.title: SFMTA ISCOTT minutes — October 22, 2026 — Winter Walk
source.text: The October 22, 2026 ISCOTT minutes list Winter Walk closures on Grant Avenue between Geary and Post and on Maiden Lane between Kearny and Stockton, including their intersection. Item C records December 4 at 6 a.m. through December 30 at 6 p.m., 2026, and an approval vote. These are source facts; the fictional pilot terms below are not official permit conditions.

messages.speaker: Garage advocate
messages.text: Fictional simulation: Can we compromise while protecting legally available delivery access until 6 p.m.? I propose exploring an after-6 pilot with a step-free route and visible access to the tea shop. Recorded closures apply; organizer and city access review remains unresolved.

brief: FICTIONAL DEMO: Harbor Lane Garage needs legally available delivery access protected until 6 p.m. and a clear step-free route. Saffron Kettle Tea wants discoverable evening foot traffic. Explore an after-6 pilot only if organizers and the city can approve the access plan; never assume an exemption from the recorded closure.
